scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive proof by two different exact algorithms; recognized structural toricity criterion is cited, not claimed as original. The full toric and singular distributions are the new contributions.
scientific_limitations: Exact embedded Fl(7) census over C, not all n or abstract isomorphism classes. Prior Boolean counts already known. Gao–Gui 2026 full text not inspected; historical priority provisional. Independent audit not performed.
title: Complete dimension and singularity census of toric Richardson varieties in the seven-step flag variety
